mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_no AS workerNo, name, email, password FROM worker WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, worker_no AS workerNo, name, email FROM worker WHERE worker_no = #{keyword} OR name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')
SELECT * FROM worker ORDER BY worker_no

SELECT w.worker_no AS workerNo, w.name AS workerName, wt.id AS workTimeId, wt.check_in AS checkIn, wt.check_out AS checkOut, wt.check_date AS checkDate, bt.break_start AS breakStart, bt.break_end AS breakEnd
FROM work_time wt
JOIN worker w ON wt.worker_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN break_time bt ON bt.work_time_id = wt.id WHERE wt.check_date =CURDATE()
ORDER BY w.id, wt.check_in, wt.id, bt.break_start, bt.id

SELECT wt.id AS workTimeId, w.worker_no AS workerNo, w.name AS workerName, wt.check_date AS checkDate, wt.check_in AS checkIn, wt.check_out AS checkOut, bt.break_start AS breakStart, bt.break_end AS breakEnd FROM work_time wt JOIN worker w ON wt.worker_id = w.id LEFT JOIN break_time bt ON bt.work_time_id = wt.id ORDER BY wt.check_date DESC, wt.check_in DESC

SELECT wt.id AS workTimeId, w.worker_no AS workerNo, w.name AS workerName, wt.check_date AS checkDate, wt.check_in AS checkIn, wt.check_out AS checkOut, bt.break_start AS breakStart, bt.break_end AS breakEnd FROM work_time wt JOIN worker w ON wt.worker_id = w.id LEFT JOIN break_time bt ON bt.work_time_id = wt.id WHERE wt.id = #{id} ORDER BY bt.break_start
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO worker( worker_no, name, email, password ) VALUES ( #{workerNo}, #{name}, #{email}, #{password} )
